UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile document containing non-PII display metadata.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the UI.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

SajuReading.title: SajuReading
SajuReading.description: Saved personal Saju calculation and Gemini AI interpretation report.

nickname.description: Nickname or subject label for the reading.

targetYear.description: Target year for the yearly fortune section.

displayMeta.description: Formatted display labels for calendar, time, and gender.

calculation.description: Deterministic Manseryeok four pillars and five elements breakdown.

report.description: Structured Gemini AI Saju interpretation sections.

memo.description: Optional user reflection note attached to the reading.

isPinned.description: Whether the reading is pinned to the top of the user archive.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when reading was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when reading was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores authenticated user profile metadata scoped strictly to the owning user.

/users/{userId}/readings/{readingId}.description: Stores saved Saju calculation and AI interpretation reports owned by a specific user.
